@about: Router carving add-on (0.9 SU.886). Words of the add-on only; the toolpath engine has none. Other languages fall back to English until the next translation run.
name: Router carving
job.name: Carving
intro: V-carve outlines, engrave lines, or carve a picture as a relief, then check the program and send it to your router. A starting point: always air-cut the first run and check the program against your machine.
host.none: This app has no drawing to read shapes from.
mode.vcarve.note: Closed outlines (letters, logos): a V-bit follows the middle of each shape, as deep as it is wide, so the walls meet the edge exactly. Holes are the shapes inside shapes.
mode.engrave.note: Follow lines and outlines at a depth, in one or more passes. A V-bit's line is as wide as it is deep.
mode.relief.note: A grey picture becomes a 3D relief: white stays at the top, black is cut to the full depth. The cutter follows the surface without cutting into it.
post.note: The text your machine needs around the cuts. {rpm} {tool} {name} {safe} {feed} {unit} are filled in. Your changes are kept for this dialect.
cad.draw.label: Draw carving toolpaths
cad.erase.label: Remove carving toolpaths
cad.draw.done: Drew {n} toolpaths on the CARVE layers.
r.timev: about {m} min (an estimate: it ignores acceleration)
r.flatyes: wider than {d} mm the floor is flat at {z} mm
r.flatno: none: every part is narrow enough for the V-bit alone
r.cellv: {p} mm per picture pixel, {step} mm between lines.
carve.warn.floor: The flat floor is left standing: choose a flat mill or the V-bit to clear it.
carve.warn.narrowfloor: The flat floor is narrower than the flat mill: the V-bit trims it, but nothing is cleared first.
preview.alt: The block as the toolpaths would cut it, darker where deeper
preview.note: Preview of the cut block, darker where deeper (it shows the cutter's shape, not the machine).
check.ok: No problems found in {cuts} cutting moves.
check.nofeed: A cutting move comes before any feed rate was set.
check.nospindle: A cut goes below the top with the spindle not started.
check.rapidcut: A rapid move crosses the work below its top.
check.outsidebed: A move goes outside the table.
check.toodeep: A cut goes deeper than the material.
check.nounit: The program never says millimetres or inches.
check.noend: The program has no end (M2 or M30).
check.nocuts: The program has no cutting moves.
check.note: The check reads the G-code back and looks for what would crash or waste a job. It does not know your machine: air-cut the first run.
carve.err.noshape: There is no closed shape to carve. Draw or select closed outlines.
carve.err.manypasses: Clearing the floor with the V-bit would take more than {count} passes. Use a flat mill, or leave the floor.
carve.err.big: The shape is too big for this resolution. Carve it in parts.
carve.err.image: That picture could not be read.
cmd.carve.help: Make carving toolpaths from the shapes with the panel's settings.
cmd.carvedraw.help: Make carving toolpaths and draw them in the drawing.
cmd.carvegcode.help: Make carving toolpaths and download the G-code.
cmd.gcode.done: G-code downloaded: {ops} operations, {lines} lines, about {minutes} min.
check.file.ok: {name}: no problems found in {cuts} cutting moves.
carve.err.file: That file could not be read.
